faq_heading: Homes near North Delta Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the North Delta Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the North Delta Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names North Delta Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near North Delta Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 321 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,191,000, townhomes $790,000, condos $470,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near North Delta Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of North Delta Secondary the median was 27 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 321 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to North Delta Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Delta Continuing Education (0.2 km east), Richardson Elementary (0.3 km north-west) and McCloskey Elementary (0.4 km south).

North Delta Secondary is a secondary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11447 82 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions North Delta Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the North Delta Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names North Delta Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of North Delta Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 321 homes sold within 2 km of North Delta Secondary: 182 houses, 35 townhomes and 75 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,191,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of North Delta Secondary

28 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of North Delta Secondary in a straight line (19 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Delta Continuing Education, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cougar Creek Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Richardson Elementary (0.3 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Richardson Elementary (0.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: Delta Continuing Education (0.2 km east), Sands Secondary (1.2 km west), Burnsview Secondary (1.4 km south), Delview Secondary (1.7 km north), Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry) (2.8 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Sands Secondary, 1.2 km west of North Delta Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near North Delta Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from North Delta Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past North Delta Secondary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of North Delta Secondary was $1,191,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Delta Continuing Education, the nearest other secondary school, 0.2 km east of North Delta Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
